task: review checks: accounting of known leaks and non-leaks, escalated-only task type, input-size estimator, 'matches all features', prompts and template pools

release_blocking.alignment: audit k of a cell: the k-th full-size permuted draw of each attribute, on the same captures; each attribute's labels permuted with its own stream (seed, 1, attribute stream, k), so independently across attributes

matches_all.rule: A feature family matches all features when the 95% cluster-bootstrap CI of the paired difference macro-F1(all features) - macro-F1(family alone) has a lower bound <= 0: both are out-of-fold predictions from the same 5 folds, scored on the same 1,000 resamples of whole prompt groups (seed 42), percentile interval (evaluation/stats.py paired_bootstrap_diff; a2a_leakcheck/analyze.py attribution). It says the family is not shown to fall short of all features; it is not an equivalence test, and a family whose CI lies wholly below 0 (better than all features) also matches.
